_comment: Callee ABI facts the transpiler cannot derive from pret. FAIL-CLOSED: a callee
with no entry here is not assumed to match pret, it makes the site BAIL.
Only ONE question is recorded so far, and it is the one that actually bites:
pret passes a pointer in DE, and DE maps to the 16-bit DX. A GB address fits in
16 bits so pret never had to care; a port HOST address is 32 bits and does not,
and COFF rejects the relocation outright rather than truncating it. So every
port routine that takes such a pointer had to put it somewhere else, and where
it put it is a per-routine decision recorded at the routine.
Each entry cites the file:line of the port's own signature comment. That is
repository evidence at the definition, not inference from call sites.

MoveSprite.evidence: dos_port/src/home/pathfinding.asm:72 — 'EDI = flat pointer to $ff-terminated movement-direction bytes'

SaveEndBattleTextPointers.evidence: dos_port/src/home/trainers.asm:616 — 'In: ESI = win text (flat), EDX = lose text (flat)'

_comment: These take a DE pointer too, and are LEFT OUT on purpose. Their port
signature comments do not settle where the pointer goes, and a plausible
guess here would be invisible in review — the emitted code would assemble,
link and run while reading the wrong memory. They bail instead; ~24 sites.
